feed.title: Tokenization Systems: comment letters
feed.subtitle: Federal comment letters and international standard-setter responses, newest first. 148 recommendations across twenty-seven federal letters.

entry.title: FinCEN A7 Network special measure comment
entry.summary: The proposal places nearly all of its work on convertible virtual currency (CVC) on the receiving institution, although FinCEN itself assesses that there are "few, if any, readily available ways" for that institution to reject an incoming transfer before receipt, and it does not say what the rule would require of the payment stablecoin issuers that are about to become covered by it. Filed November 4, 2026 on a proposed ban on transfers of funds involving the A7 Network's Sub-Agents; 5 recommendations; comment period closed; final action pending.

entry.title: SEC transfer agent rules comment
entry.summary: The proposal lets a crypto network carry the master securityholder file, the authoritative record of who owns an issuer's securities, but does not say which record governs when a token and the off-chain file disagree, does not require that a token's supply be reconciled to the file, and does not define exclusive control for a ledger the transfer agent shares with everyone else on the network. Filed November 3, 2026 on the SEC's proposed modernization of its transfer agent rules; 7 recommendations; comment period closed; final action pending.

entry.title: SEC tokenized stock exemptions comment
entry.summary: Several of the Order's conditions turn on facts the public ledger already shows, but the Order collects them as descriptions of procedure, only for a venue's own contracts, or not at all; a five-year exemption meant to inform rulemaking should collect them from its first day, in a form checkable against the ledger. Filed October 19, 2026 on temporary exemptions for venues and liquidity providers trading tokenized stock; 7 recommendations; open for comment; no deadline set.

entry.title: Treasury GENIUS Act issuance, offer and sale supplemental comment (correction of two statements about the program's index)
entry.summary: A correction to the October 13 comment: the index's score of record for the issuer in Recommendation 2 is 0.90, not 0.95, and the anchors Recommendation 1 called published are stated in the comment itself; no recommendation changes. Filed October 19, 2026 on who may issue payment stablecoins and who may offer or sell them; supplements No. 22; comment period closed; final action pending.

entry.title: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets comment
entry.summary: The proposed investment contract safe harbor conditions a permanent change in a crypto asset's status on facts measurable from public data but tests them only through the issuer's own certification; the more objective standard the SEC asks about has at its core a definition of control the Commission has already written. Filed October 19, 2026 on Regulation Crypto Assets, the SEC's proposed offering regime for crypto assets; 8 recommendations; comment period closed; final action pending.

entry.title: Treasury GENIUS Act issuance, offer and sale comment
entry.summary: Of the two facts a provider's reliance on a foreign issuer's representation turns on under the proposed rule, the issuer's technological capability to comply with a lawful order is readable from its deployed contract and on-chain history, while whether it will comply is not observable at all; the rule should name the observable check as a floor. Filed October 13, 2026 on who may issue payment stablecoins and who may offer or sell them; 7 recommendations; comment period closed; final action pending.

entry.title: FDIC disclosure of information comment
entry.summary: Supervisory material reaches the public by exception; a standing, safeguarded channel for aggregated analysis would let the supervisory process be examined before a failure, not after. Filed October 5, 2026 on when the FDIC and others may disclose confidential information; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: CFTC clearing organization requirements comment
entry.summary: Clearing organizations must now show, instrument by instrument, that a tokenized asset conveys the traditional asset's rights, yet the Commission's collection captures that determination in no defined form. Filed October 5, 2026 on renewal of the reporting requirements for derivatives clearing organizations; 4 recommendations; omb review pending.

entry.title: Comment to the Federal Reserve on its anti-money-laundering program rule
entry.summary: Four agencies are writing one anti-money-laundering program rule four times, and the only substantive divergence in the Board's version is the coordination mechanism itself. Filed September 21, 2026 on anti-money-laundering programs for the banks the Federal Reserve supervises; 9 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC deposit insurance assessments comment
entry.summary: The cohort the assessment rule reclassifies carries measurably higher run risk than the cohort it is priced against; the framework prices size and resolvability, not novel-activity exposure. Filed August 24, 2026 on deposit insurance assessment thresholds, rates and adjustments; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC resolution submissions comment
entry.summary: The rule narrows what covered institutions must submit for resolution planning, and the content it removes is disproportionately the content that predicts a run. Filed August 24, 2026 on what large insured banks must submit to the FDIC for resolution planning; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to FinCEN on customer identification programs for stablecoin issuers

category.label: FinCEN (joint with OCC, Board, FDIC, NCUA)

entry.summary: The account definition does two jobs in the GENIUS Act framework; the proposal codifies one and disclaims the other in a footnote that belongs in binding regulatory text. Filed August 21, 2026 on customer identification programs for stablecoin issuers; 8 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to the OCC on Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions standards for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: Supervising an issuer's anti-money-laundering and sanctions program works only when the OCC and FinCEN read the same measured control posture of one operator, and the OCC and FDIC rules align. Filed July 23, 2026 on Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions standards for the stablecoin issuers the OCC supervises; 8 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: SEC Draft Strategic Plan comment
entry.summary: Where the plan's digital-asset objectives turn on whether a system is decentralized, decentralization must be measured against a reproducible standard the plan does not yet name. Filed July 2, 2026 on the SEC's draft strategic plan for fiscal years 2026 through 2030; 4 recommendations; plan published september 2, 2026.

entry.title: FSB AI Sound Practices response (first international standard-setter filing)
entry.summary: All seven consultation questions answered, anchored by the first control-layer measurement of live agentic payments: autonomous agents already executing irreversible payments through a settlement layer no institution governs. Filed July 1, 2026 on Sound Practices for Responsible Adoption of Artificial Intelligence; international response; final report published october 15, 2026.

entry.title: Comment to the FDIC on Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions standards for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: The FDIC's supervision-and-coordination layer over an issuer's anti-money-laundering and sanctions program works only when the FDIC and FinCEN read the same measured control posture of one operator. Filed June 30, 2026 on Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions standards for the stablecoin issuers the FDIC supervises; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: NCUA GENIUS supplemental comment (routing table and suggested rule text)
entry.summary: A supplement to the NCUA comment: a routing table keyed to the questions, a cross-agency alignment map, and suggested rule text for the five priority asks. Filed June 22, 2026 on GENIUS Act standards for stablecoin issuers licensed by the NCUA; supplements No. 11; final rule pending.

entry.title: NCUA GENIUS stablecoin comment (completes GENIUS-agency coverage)
entry.summary: Stablecoin issuance standards for NCUA-licensed credit unions, the credit-union analogue of the OCC rule. Completes coverage of every GENIUS-implementing agency. Filed June 22, 2026 on GENIUS Act standards for stablecoin issuers licensed by the NCUA; 11 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN-OFAC stablecoin issuer rule: supplemental comment (reserve-concentration causal evidence)
entry.summary: A supplement strengthening Recommendation 6: risk assessments by permitted payment stablecoin issuers must address reserve-custody concentration. Filed June 9, 2026 on anti-money-laundering and sanctions programs for stablecoin issuers; supplements No. 6; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN anti-money-laundering rule: supplemental comment (effective-control evidence)
entry.summary: A supplement strengthening Recommendation 4: the United States based anti-money-laundering officer should hold effective supervisory control, not a nominal title. Filed June 9, 2026 on FinCEN's proposed rewrite of anti-money-laundering program rules; supplements No. 5; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to the FDIC on its requirements and standards for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: Recommendation 7 proposes an MVEP-gated conditional deposit insurance pass-through in place of the proposed rule's categorical bar on pass-through coverage for stablecoin reserve deposits, attaching to the reserve deposit at the insured bank rather than the stablecoin. Filed April 20, 2026 on requirements and standards for the stablecoin issuers the FDIC supervises; 12 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to the banking agencies on their joint anti-money-laundering program rule
entry.summary: Banks increasingly perform control-layer functions in tokenized finance: custody of stablecoin issuers' reserves, tokenized deposit issuance, tokenized securities custody, operating as a federal qualified payment stablecoin issuer, and correspondent services to issuers. Filed April 18, 2026 on anti-money-laundering program requirements for banks; 7 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to FinCEN and OFAC on anti-money-laundering and sanctions programs for stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: The joint proposed rule operationalizes the first statutory control-layer mandate in U.S. financial regulation: the GENIUS Act block, freeze and reject capability across primary and secondary markets. Filed April 18, 2026 on anti-money-laundering and sanctions programs for stablecoin issuers; 10 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to FinCEN on its proposed anti-money-laundering program rule
entry.summary: Anti-money-laundering regulation has always been control-layer regulation: the Bank Secrecy Act attaches obligations to intermediaries, not to transactions or instruments. Filed April 18, 2026 on FinCEN's proposed rewrite of anti-money-laundering program rules; 7 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Comment to the FDIC on its application rule for stablecoin-issuing subsidiaries
entry.summary: The application is the FDIC's first chance to map a prospective permitted payment stablecoin issuer's control-layer topology, shaping both the approval decision and the baseline for ongoing supervision. Filed April 18, 2026 on how banks the FDIC supervises apply to issue stablecoins through a subsidiary; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Treasury GENIUS Act state-similarity comment
entry.summary: Treasury must judge fifty state frameworks substantially similar to the federal GENIUS Act framework; the proposed principles reduce this to section-by-section comparison against statutory text. Filed April 15, 2026 on principles for deciding when a state stablecoin regime is substantially similar to the federal one; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: OCC stablecoin issuer rule: supplemental comment (control-layer extension)
entry.summary: A user transacting in a stablecoin from a permitted payment stablecoin issuer, through an interface covered by the SEC staff statement on Covered User Interface Providers, receives none of the twelve interface-conduct conditions; the protection gradient is inverted. Filed April 13, 2026 on GENIUS Act rules for the stablecoin issuers the OCC supervises; 1 recommendation; final rule published october 23, 2026.

entry.title: Comment to the OCC on its stablecoin issuer rule, applying the MVEP
entry.summary: Three tokenized Treasury products under three regimes receive comparable collateral treatment on Binance through Ceffu, with no disclosure of which instrument backs a given trade. Filed April 10, 2026 on GENIUS Act rules for the stablecoin issuers the OCC supervises; 3 recommendations; final rule published october 23, 2026.
